parameters.query: SELECT email, ip_address, COUNT(*) as attempts, MAX(attempted_at) as last_attempt FROM login_attempts WHERE success = false AND attempted_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY email, ip_address HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY attempts DESC

SELECT email, COUNT(*) as login_count, array_agg(DISTINCT ip_address) as ips FROM login_attempts WHERE success = true AND attempted_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY email HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) > 3

{{ $json.alerts.filter(a => a.type === 'brute_force').map(a => `INSERT INTO security_events (event_type, user_email, ip_address, details, risk_level) VALUES ('brute_force_detected', '${a.email}', '${a.ip}', '{"attempts": ${a.attempts}}'::jsonb, 'high')`).join('; ') || 'SELECT 1' }}
